name: LCRA
description: Controlled generators, frozen logistic parameters and scorer specifications, exact quantiles, materialized program-generated inputs and per-case evaluation records for Latent-Control Robust Aggregation (LCRA). The package includes retrospective replay of 40 Phase 3B, 40 Phase 3C and 100 Phase 4 opened records, complete controlled score distributions, a 22,464-construction categorical audit and margin diagnostics. Negative results are retained. Natural captured content, original annotation returns, private seeds and third-party neural-model weights are not included. Natural training reproduction and reliable natural transfer are not claimed. Verification was performed by the same AI assistant and is not independent human replication. Code and program-generated data have separate licenses as described in the archive. Historical frozen files retain their original terminology to preserve hashes.
